concept.setting: an orc war-town in a red rock canyon desert under a hot orange sky
concept.buildings: round and oval huts on low red sandstone and terracotta walls, roofs of stretched brown and tan hides over curved timber ribs, great curved tusk-like timbers and iron spikes jutting from every roof ridge and doorway, rusted iron plates bolted over the walls, bone and skull ornaments, heavy log palisades with sharpened tops
concept.landmark: a towering great hall fortress on a rock outcrop: tiers of spiked hide-and-timber roofs over thick red stone walls, giant curved tusks framing its gate, smoke rising from braziers on every tier
concept.street_life: fire braziers and torches along the paths, war drums on wooden stands, weapon racks and training dummies, tanning racks with drying hides, a wolf kennel with gnawed bones, cookfire spits, spiky wagons at a dusty market
concept.greenery: sparse and harsh: thorny scrub, dry yellow grass, twisted dead trees, barrel cactus, a muddy oasis pool with reeds
concept.materials: red sandstone, orange, red and brown terracotta, acacia and dark oak logs, brown and orange wool for hides, iron bars and chains, bone blocks, campfires, lanterns
